about: Special-occasion buses for the bus replay. 'occasions' says which sprites a day gets, by deck: dd double, sd single, td night (the triple decker). The replay exporter (E:\Road Data\platform\export_replay.py, on NRG-1) stamps them into that day's replay file, so the day keeps its buses for good, saved files included; the viewer (static/js/ngbus-replay.js) draws them, and the ordinary buses whenever anything is missing. 'sprites' gives each sprite's file in this folder, its viewBox, and its anchor: the point that sits on the bus's position (the bottom of the wheels; for a sprite without wheels, the bottom of the drawing). Sprites from Claude Design's 'London bus graphic styles', tried on the map in the sprite workbench. Keep every sprite a stamped day has used: old replay files and saved copies still name them.
